value.rationale: The motivating 2024 classification fixes the number and alternating stability of meridian cycles, but gives no physical-time or stability-scale diagnostics. Varying the affine cofactor to its natural zero boundary and independently varying the torus aspect toward horn pinching reveal two geometrically motivated routes to the same square-root infinite period, with opposite transverse behavior (zero versus fixed return multiplier and nonzero versus vanishing physical-time Floquet exponent). Exact constants, a global return law, and simultaneous four-cycle loss supply meaningful dynamical structure, rather than a parameter-name substitution or isolated numerical slice.
